tutorial.info: This shows the round number, ante, dead-hand size, the four boodle cards with the chips staked on them, the current sequence, and each player's chips and status. Michigan (Newmarket) is a 'stops' chip-betting game.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. During the play phase, cards you may legally play are highlighted; click one to play it in an ascending same-suit run.
tutorial.actions: On your bet turn, distribute your chips across the four boodles and place your bets. During play, click a playable card. At the result phase, deal the next round.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game and start over.
